name: Great Texas Birding Classic Conservation Grants

funder.name: Texas Parks and Wildlife Department (Great Texas Birding Classic)

summary: Conservation grants funded by Birding Classic proceeds for avian habitat restoration, enhancement and acquisition projects anywhere in Texas; organisations propose projects and winning birding teams choose which approved projects get funded.
